summary: This note is a short biographical entry on Anne Simonett. It describes her family background as the daughter of Minnesota Supreme Court Justice John E. Simonett, and traces her education: a music degree from Lawrence University, a master's in music performance from Yale University, and a law degree from Harvard University in 1981.
one_line: Biographical note on Anne Simonett, daughter of a Minnesota Supreme Court justice, with music and law degrees from Lawrence, Yale and Harvard.
key_facts: Anne Simonett is the daughter of Minnesota Supreme Court Justice John E. Simonett.
Anne Simonett received a degree in music from Lawrence University in Appleton, Wisconsin.
Anne Simonett received a masters degree in music performance from Yale University.
Anne Simonett graduated from Yale University "magna cum laude" with her master's degree in music performance.
Anne Simonett received her law degree from Harvard University in 1981.
